function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT
  pl.vendor_id,
  v.vendor_name,
  pl.vendor_invoice_no,
  SUM(pl.qty * pl.unit_price_orig * (pl.fx_rate - aug_avg.fx_rate)) AS fx_effect_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor v ON pl.vendor_id = v.vendor_id
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT AVG(fx_rate) AS fx_rate
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
  WHERE currency = 'USD'
    AND period = '2026-08'
) aug_avg
WHERE pl.currency = 'USD'
  AND pl.period = '2026-09'
GROUP BY pl.vendor_id, v.vendor_name, pl.vendor_invoice_no
ORDER BY fx_effect_cad DESC
LIMIT 10","purpose":"Breakdown of FX effect by vendor and invoice for Sep USD purchase lines"}
